guide.title: Fertilizer Calculator User Guide
guide.subtitle: Follow this concise guide to get precise, eco-friendly fertilization dosages.
guide.dontShowAgain: Do not show automatically when opening this page

step1.title: Select Crop Commodity
step1.desc: Specify your cultivated crop (Rice, Corn, Chili, Oil Palm, etc.). LoopTani adjusts formulas based on official agronomic standards.
step1.tip: Each crop has specific macro nutrient requirements (N, P, K) for optimal harvest yields.

step2.title: Specify Land Area & Soil Type
step2.desc: Enter your land area (Hectares or m²) and select soil type (Loam, Clay, Sandy, or Peat) for nutrient retention adjustments.

step3.title: Choose Crop Growth Stage
step3.desc: Select the current plant stage: Vegetative (early shoot & leaf growth) or Generative (flowering & fruiting) to avoid over-fertilization.

step4.title: Get Precise Dosage & Circular Solutions
step4.desc: View the chemical fertilizer breakdown (Urea, SP-36, KCl / NPK) and local circular organic fertilizer recommendations directly orderable from farming partners.
